overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that stop-loss orders would automatically bypass swing-trade counting, but did not verify that the compliance guard actually exempts stop-triggered exits from the quarterly swing-trade cap.
why_it_breaks: The test verifies that stop-loss orders bypass cooldown and minimum-size checks, but the compliance guard that enforces the quarterly swing-trade cap was not updated to exempt stop-triggered exits. When three positions were sold via stop-loss (all held under the minimum period), they were correctly marked with reason='stop' and bypassed churn rules, but were still counted as swing trades, causing the breach of the documented cap of 2.

evidence.quote: Hard drawdown rules bypass minimum-hold checks.
Stop tests assert the reason is stop.
